description: The bar chart illustrates benchmark scores for three Korean language models across multiple evaluation datasets, showing side-by-side performance per dataset and an overall average. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, with no additional axis label shown; the categories appear in this fixed order rather than being sorted by value. The vertical axis is a numeric score scale (no explicit label visible) with values presented as decimals on top of bars; the plotted values range from about 0.42 up to 1.00, suggesting a linear scale. Each category contains a grouped set of three vertical bars corresponding to the legend: RedWhale (our) in dark purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) in light gray. For PT-EVAL, the dark purple bar is 0.42 and the light blue bar is 0.46, while the light gray bar reaches 1.00; for KoBEST-BQ, the dark purple bar is 0.52, the light blue bar is 0.56, and the light gray bar is 1.00; for KoBEST-CP, the dark purple bar is 0.71, the light blue bar is 0.74, and the light gray bar is 1.00; for KoBEST-HS, the dark purple bar is 0.50, the light blue bar is 0.54, and the light gray bar is 1.00; for KoBEST-SN, the dark purple bar is 0.69, the light blue bar is 0.73, and the light gray bar is 1.00; and for AVG, the dark purple bar is 0.57, the light blue bar is 0.61, and the light gray bar is 1.00. The bars are not stacked; they are grouped in triplets with consistent color coding and numeric annotations above each bar, and no bars appear specially highlighted beyond these value labels.
